desc: Build an adjacency list containing undirected edges \((x,y,z)\) for all constraints.
Traverse each unvisited vertex iteratively, assign XOR potentials, and verify consistency for every edge, including self-loops and duplicate edges.
Collect vertices and potentials per component, then choose the component XOR offset independently for each bit to minimize the sum.
Construct and output \(A_v=P_v\oplus T\) for every vertex, including isolated vertices; output `-1` on inconsistency.
Use efficient input parsing and iterative traversal for \(N\le 2\cdot10^5\), \(M\le10^5\).
